value.zh-CN: 当前标签，可 `bind:value`。不传时由组件自行管理；`null` 表示受控且没有标签；单向 `value={x}` 只作初值，要完全受控用函数绑定 `bind:value={get, set}`；绑成 `undefined` 会清空标签。没有 defaultValue。
value.en-US: Current tags, supports `bind:value`. Left out, the component manages them; `null` means controlled with no tags; a one-way `value={x}` only seeds them, and for a fully controlled input use the function binding `bind:value={get, set}`. Binding it to `undefined` clears the tags. There is no defaultValue.

inputValue.zh-CN: 当前输入框内容，可 `bind:inputValue`。不传时由组件自行管理；要完全受控用函数绑定 `bind:inputValue={get, set}`；绑成 `undefined` 会清空输入。
inputValue.en-US: Current input text, supports `bind:inputValue`. Left out, the component manages it; for a fully controlled text use the function binding `bind:inputValue={get, set}`. Binding it to `undefined` clears the text.

maxTagCount.zh-CN: 标签的最大展示数量，超出后以 +N 形式展示。
maxTagCount.en-US: Maximum number of tags shown; the rest are shown as +N.

showRestTagsPopover.zh-CN: 超过 maxTagCount 后，hover 到 +N 时是否通过 Popover 显示剩余标签。
showRestTagsPopover.en-US: Whether hovering +N shows the remaining tags in a Popover once maxTagCount is exceeded.

restTagsPopoverProps.zh-CN: +N 浮层的 Popover 属性，不含 content、child、children。
restTagsPopoverProps.en-US: Popover props of the +N popover, without content, child and children.

showContentTooltip.zh-CN: 标签文字被截断时，hover 标签是否通过浮层显示全部内容；传对象时可指定浮层类型与透传给浮层的属性。
showContentTooltip.en-US: Whether hovering a truncated tag shows its full text in an overlay; an object picks the overlay type and the props passed to it.

allowDuplicates.zh-CN: 是否允许添加相同的标签。
allowDuplicates.en-US: Whether the same tag can be added more than once.

addOnBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开组件时，是否将输入框内容自动创建为标签。
addOnBlur.en-US: Whether the input text becomes a tag when the focus leaves the component.

draggable.en-US: Whether tags can be reordered by dragging.

expandRestTagsOnClick.zh-CN: 不可拖拽时，焦点进入组件（点击、Tab 或 focus 方法）后是否展开被折叠的标签。
expandRestTagsOnClick.en-US: When not draggable, whether the collapsed tags expand once focus enters the component (click, Tab or the focus method).

placeholder.zh-CN: 没有标签时输入框的占位文字。
placeholder.en-US: Placeholder of the input while there are no tags.

insetLabelId.zh-CN: 内嵌标签容器的 id，供 aria-labelledby 引用。
insetLabelId.en-US: id of the inset label container, for aria-labelledby.

separator.zh-CN: 批量输入时的分隔符，可传多个；传 null 不拆分。
separator.en-US: Separator(s) for adding several tags at once; null disables splitting.

showClear.zh-CN: 是否显示一键清除所有标签和输入内容的按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether to show the button that clears all tags and the input text.

split.zh-CN: 自定义分隔符处理函数，返回拆分后的字符串数组。
split.en-US: Custom split function that returns the split strings.

validateStatus.zh-CN: 校验状态，仅影响样式；error 时输入框带 aria-invalid。
validateStatus.en-US: Validation status, which only affects styling; error also sets aria-invalid on the input.

autofocus.zh-CN: 挂载时是否自动聚焦输入框并激活组件，禁用时不生效。
autofocus.en-US: Whether the input is focused and the component activated on mount; ignored when disabled.

preventScroll.zh-CN: 组件内 focus 方法是否阻止浏览器滚动到新聚焦的元素。
preventScroll.en-US: Whether the focus calls inside the component stop the browser from scrolling the focused element into view.

onInputChange.zh-CN: 输入框内容变化时调用；事件对象可能是 input、keydown、focusout、click 或 composition 事件，读取专有字段前先按 event.type 收窄。
onInputChange.en-US: Called when the input text changes. The event may be an input, keydown, focusout, click or composition event; narrow it by event.type before reading its own fields.

onAdd.zh-CN: 添加标签时调用，参数为新增的标签。
onAdd.en-US: Called when tags are added, with the added tags.

onRemove.zh-CN: 移除标签时调用，参数为被移除的标签及其序号。
onRemove.en-US: Called when a tag is removed, with the removed tag and its index.

onExceed.zh-CN: 添加后超过 max 时调用，参数为截断前的完整列表。
onExceed.en-US: Called when adding would exceed max, with the whole list before it is cut.

onInputExceed.zh-CN: 输入内容超过 maxLength 时调用，参数为被拒绝的输入内容。
onInputExceed.en-US: Called when the input text exceeds maxLength, with the rejected input text.

onFocus.zh-CN: 焦点从组件外进入时调用一次；焦点在输入框、标签、清除按钮之间移动不调用。
onFocus.en-US: Called once when the focus enters from outside; moving between the input, tags and clear button does not call it.

onBlur.zh-CN: 焦点离开整个组件时调用一次；焦点在组件内部移动不调用。
onBlur.en-US: Called once when the focus leaves the whole component; moving inside it does not call it.

onKeyDown.zh-CN: 输入框按键时在组件处理之后调用；其中调用 preventDefault 不会阻止 Enter 添加标签。
onKeyDown.en-US: Called on keydown in the input after the component handled it; calling preventDefault there does not stop Enter from adding a tag.

onclick.zh-CN: 点击根元素时在组件自己的激活处理之后调用。
onclick.en-US: Called on a click on the root element, after the component's own activation handling.

prefix.zh-CN: 输入框前缀的 snippet，文字或图标会自动带上左右间隔。
prefix.en-US: Snippet for the prefix of the input; text or an icon gets side spacing automatically.

suffix.zh-CN: 输入框后缀的 snippet，文字或图标会自动带上左右间隔。
suffix.en-US: Snippet for the suffix of the input; text or an icon gets side spacing automatically.

insetLabel.zh-CN: 内嵌标签的 snippet，显示在输入框前；同时提供 prefix 时只显示 prefix。显示时，没有 aria-label、aria-labelledby 的输入框以它命名。
insetLabel.en-US: Snippet for the inset label shown before the input; when prefix is also given, only prefix is shown. When shown, it names an input that has no aria-label or aria-labelledby.

clearIcon.zh-CN: 替换清除按钮中图标的 snippet；内容为空时使用默认图标。
clearIcon.en-US: Snippet that replaces the icon in the clear button; empty content keeps the default icon.

tag.zh-CN: 整体替换单个标签的 snippet，参数为 `{ value, index, onClose }`；内容为空时不渲染该标签，不回落默认标签。
tag.en-US: Snippet that replaces each tag as a whole, receiving `{ value, index, onClose }`; empty content renders no tag and does not fall back to the default tag.

focus.zh-CN: 使输入框获得焦点并激活组件。
focus.en-US: Focuses the input and activates the component.

blur.zh-CN: 使组件内任意持有焦点的元素（输入框、标签、清除按钮）失去焦点。
blur.en-US: Removes focus from whichever element inside the component holds it (input, tag or clear button).
